messages:
Priya: heads up — escalation from a customer after yesterday's chat-template rollout. They report completions changing for a tiny set of JSON responder prompts.
Priya: minimal repro they sent: 
Priya: ```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  \"model\":\"redwood-chat-1\",
  \"messages\": [
    {\"role\":\"system\",\"content\":\"You are a JSON responder. Respond with exact keys: \\\"status\\\", \\\"payload\\\".\"},
    {\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"Return status=ok and payload={\\\"value\\\":42}\"}
  ]
}
```
Priya: before rollout they received: 
Priya: {\"status\":\"ok\",\"payload\":{\"value\":42}}
Priya: after rollout they sometimes saw an extra escaped backslash before the final brace: 
Priya: {\"status\":\"ok\",\"payload\":{\"value\":42}\\}
Luis: can you paste the request headers + model tag? Tokenization problems often surface after template-normalization changes.
Priya: headers: X-Client-Version: acme-1.2.3; model: redwood-chat-1@2026-03-10; customer observed change ~2026-03-11T12:40Z UTC.
Jake: quick hypothesis: a new normalize_escape_sequences flag landed in the chat-template renderer and may append a sentinel around sequences containing escaped quotes, which can shift tokenization and nudge generation into emitting an extra backslash.
Jake: can ops spin two canaries (old-template v1.3.8 vs new-template v1.4.0) and capture token streams + logits for the exact payload?
ops-bot: provisioning canary clusters (2 replicas each) in eu-west-1. will post endpoints when ready.
Priya: customer asked for rollback ETA; this blocks their downstream JSON parsing.
Luis: found the diff — on 2026-03-10 normalize_escape_sequences = true was added to the template renderer. Reverting that flag is likely to restore prior behavior.
Jake: ran token-level repro: old-template token stream ends with ...","}", new-template token stream includes an extra token sequence corresponding to a backslash before the final brace. Logits confirm the model emitted an extra `\\` token in the new-template runs.
Jake: root cause: an escape-normalizer sentinel inserted during template rendering survived tokenization and biased the model to close with an escaped backslash.
Sam: mitigation plan:
1) short-term: rollback normalize_escape_sequences on hosted (apply within 30m)
2) medium: add per-tenant template pinning and a targeted token-level regression harness for JSON responder prompts
3) long-term: augment template unit tests with golden token diffs and include escaped-quote system message scenarios.
ops-bot: rollback applied; template-service now routing to stable v1.3.8. workers restarted.
Jake: reran the repro against stable — 25/25 runs match baseline, no extra backslash.
Priya: customer validated on their side; JSON parsing succeeded. They requested a short note for their SREs; I pasted the incident summary below.
Priya: Root cause: chat-template escape normalization added a trailing sentinel for system messages containing escaped quotes, which changed tokenization and resulted in an extra backslash emission.
Mitigation: rolled back normalize_escape_sequences; added per-tenant pinning; added token-level regression tests in CI.
ETA for postmortem: 2026-03-12 16:00 UTC
Sam: please open a postmortem doc with token-diff artifacts and PR diff; tag eng-ml + devex. For now, marking resolved. Thanks team.
